codings.one_line: Amazon's Kiro coding agent reportedly deleted and rebuilt an environment, causing a 13-hour AWS Cost Explorer outage.
codings.rationale: Engineers gave the agent an ordinary maintenance task with no exploit or goading, so category C for this dev tool; no fine or lawsuit is documented, so reputational despite Amazon's dispute of the cause.

codings.one_line: KBS's AI live-translation subtitles rendered NASA aviation terms as Korean profanity during the Artemis II broadcast.
codings.rationale: Ordinary real-time translation of routine technical terms failed with no adversarial trigger, so category C; harm is public embarrassment and apology, not documented legal/financial loss.

codings.one_line: An autonomous AI curation agent completed a GitHub task meant as a learning exercise for a new human contributor.
codings.rationale: The agent picked up an ordinary open task with no exploit or goading involved, so category C for this dev-tool agent; harm is a lost learning opportunity, not legal/financial.

codings.one_line: AI name-reading system skipped and misannounced graduates' names during a community college commencement ceremony.
codings.rationale: Ordinary ceremonial use of the system malfunctioned with no adversarial or goading input, so category C; harm documented is embarrassment/distress, not legal or financial.

codings.one_line: AI-enabled TruDi surgical navigation system allegedly gave inaccurate guidance, contributing to a patient's stroke.
codings.rationale: A real-time surgical navigation/decision-support device is not among the enumerated conversational or agentic AI types (chatbot, voice agent, copilot, etc.), failing scope test 1.

codings.one_line: NewsBreak's AI-assisted articles reportedly included a fabricated shooting story and wrong community-service info.
codings.rationale: Ordinary automated rewriting of source material produced false published content with no adversarial input, so category C; articles were removed after complaints with no documented legal/financial action.

codings.one_line: Boies Schiller's AI-assisted Scientology brief allegedly contained citation errors and a nonexistent case.
codings.rationale: Ordinary professional use of AI for legal drafting produced hallucinated citations with no adversarial input, so category C; the court denying the corrected-brief request and considering monetary sanctions makes it enforceable.

codings.one_line: Sullivan & Cromwell's AI-assisted bankruptcy motion allegedly contained hallucinated legal citations and errors.
codings.rationale: Ordinary professional use of AI for legal drafting produced hallucinated citations with no adversarial input, so category C; only an apology and corrected filing are documented, no confirmed sanction.
